findings.finding: Reddit is an advertising platform: advertising was $847.0M of $895.0M Q3 2026 revenue (94.6%); 'other' (content licensing to AI model makers, products) $48.0M (5.4%), growing 35% y/y vs advertising +54%. Revenue = DAUq x ARPU; logged-in and app users carry over 80% of monetization per management.

Q3 2026 growth is monetization, not audience: US revenue +50% y/y while US DAUq fell 2% (50.7M vs 51.6M), so US ARPU +53% ($13.82 vs $9.04) carries it (ad load, pricing, advertiser count). International: DAUq +24% and ARPU +32%. Global DAUq 130.3M, flat q/q. The residual is zero in the ads_platform identity check (econ review consistent).

Search referrals fell through Q3 and into October (more than 1M fewer per week); management said that at this rate total DAUq could fall by a low double-digit percent in Q4 from 130M. Logged-out users are 76.8M of 130.3M (59%) and US logged-out fell 4% y/y; the 10-Q says the decline may continue and worsen. The company will test logged-in-only access in non-US markets from Q4 2026, which can cut reach further.

Demand is funded by advertisers' budgets, no customer or advertiser is 10% of revenue and none is named; no country other than the US is 10% (US 80.3% of Q3 revenue by billing address). Contracted revenue is tiny: RPO over one year $62.4M, deferred revenue $38.8M; there is no take-or-pay or vendor financing. Firm obligations run the other way: cloud commitments AWS $880M (to Jun 2029) and Google Cloud $580M (to Aug 2029).

Structural treatment: the history is a scale-up (revenue $667M 2022 to $2,203M 2025, operating margin -26% to +20%) with no completed ad cycle in the data; the ads_platform model is not price-cyclical. Ad budgets are cyclical by nature, which belongs to the bear case and not to a cycle-average margin.

Revenue beat the guided midpoint 8 of 8 quarters (mean ratio 1.099), but the beat shrank to 1.035 in Q3 2026, the smallest in eight quarters, and the Q4 2026 guide ($1,000-1,030M, about +40% y/y) is set after the traffic warning. The guide is a floor in a growing-traffic regime; this quarter it is the honest base, without the historical beat added.

No one-offs in Q3. GAAP operating margin 29.2% is after SBC of $131.3M (14.7% of revenue, up from $85.2M in Q4 2025). Net income is flattered by a 2% tax rate (valuation allowance on US deferred tax assets; the 10-Q flags a possible large release within 12 months, a one-time gain to keep out of recurring earnings) and $27.5M interest income. FCF $362.6M (40.5% margin); capex 0.1% of revenue.

Incremental adjusted EBITDA margin 53.6% y/y; Q4 guide adjusted EBITDA $480-510M implies about 49% margin. Q3 operating margin 29% vs 10% a year earlier: part of this is a peak-growth run rate that the traffic decline can reverse.

$3,033M cash and marketable securities, no debt drawn on a $500M revolver. Buybacks $340M in 9M 2026 against SBC $301M; fully diluted shares 206.3M flat q/q, held flat only by buybacks; about $660M left on the $1.0B authorization. Advance Magazine Publishers holds about 22% and the dual-class structure concentrates voting control.

Computed high_growth / fast_grower confirmed: revenue +53% in Q3 2026 and +69% in 2025, profitable and self-funding. The question set is how long monetization growth outruns a stalling US audience, and what the margin settles at after SBC and normal tax.

flags: peak_margin_run_rate: Q3 2026 operating margin 29% vs historical median -17%; quarter x4 is not a normalized run rate (quarter review, high)
tax_normalization: 2% effective tax rate from the valuation allowance; a possible large release in the next 12 months is a one-time gain, recurring tax must normalize toward the US statutory rate
sbc_rising: SBC 14.7% of Q3 revenue and rising in dollars; dilution held flat only by $340M of 9M buybacks
traffic_dependency: 59% of DAUq is logged-out, largely search referred; Google AI features cut referrals in Q3-Q4 2026 and management warned of a low double-digit DAUq drop
logged_in_transition: planned logged-in-only experience may reduce users and ad reach; user-metric disclosure is under evaluation (disclosure-change risk)
guidance_beat_shrinking: revenue beat vs guided midpoint fell to 3.5% in Q3 2026 from about 10% average
ad_concentration: about 94% of revenue is advertising; licensing small, fixed-fee and renewal-dependent
litigation: securities class action on Google search impact, second amended complaint 2026-10-23, motion to dismiss due 2026-11-23
forensic: Piotroski 5 of 7 (mixed); Beneish and prefetch ROIC unavailable (inputs missing); Altman Z'' 16 safe

economics.reason: A scale-up with no completed advertising cycle in its four-year history and an ads model that is not price-cyclical; ad-budget sensitivity and the traffic shock are carried in the bear case.

gaps: no advertiser concentration or licensing contract values disclosed
